people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Produce your cause,” says Yahweh. “Bring out your strong reasons!” says the King of Jacob.
translations.bsb: “Present your case,” says the LORD. “Submit your arguments,” says the King of Jacob.
translations.kjv: Produce your cause, saith the LORD; bring forth your strong reasons, saith the King of Jacob.
translations.asv: Produce your cause, saith Jehovah; bring forth your strong reasons, saith the King of Jacob.
